!Series_overall_design = Lung cancer cell lines (H358, H2122, H23, H441) transduced with dCas9-KRAB and pooled dual sgRNA libraries targeting approximately 100 genes were injected into the flanks of NSG mice to form mosaic xenografts. Two days post-implantation, mice were treated with Sotorasib ($100~mg/\text{kg}$) or vehicle. Dosing was performed by daily oral gavage for 13 days. Tumors were excised on day 14, and genomic DNA (gDNA) was extracted for subsequent guide RNA sequencing to quantify gene enrichment/depletion (Rho scores) and determine genetic dependencies.

!Series_overall_design = Lung cancer patient-derived organoids from four genetic backgrounds (KRAS G12C, KRAS G12D, EML4-ALK fusion, and EGFR L858R) were pooled and grown in 3D Matrigel culture. These pooled PDOs were exposed to an ARS-1620 dosage series. After treatment, cells were dissociated and processed using 10x Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3' v3.1 chemistry. Libraries were demultiplexed using SNP-based assignment from scRNA-seq reads and hashed sample tags (MULTI-seq). Single-cell transcriptomes were quantified using Cell Ranger and integrated into downstream analyses to assess differential drug responses.
!Series_supplementary_file = ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE311nnn/GSE311811/suppl/GSE311811_RAW.tar
